notes: The *also* of *as he had done also to Libnah* is given to the waw of וְכַאֲשֶׁר; a waw is present, so rule 51 marks nothing added.
נֶפֶשׁ carries no article morpheme in this verse, unlike the parallel clauses elsewhere in the chapter, so the supplied *the* goes with the noun (rules 15, 46).
The directive he on דְבִרָה is `unrepresented`, the לְ having taken the *to* (rule 32).
